verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented export-all or data-takeout feature, no statement about open export formats, and nothing about account closure or leaving. The Files API's ability to read files and list folders is a developer building block a user could script into an export; it is not a first-party export capability, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
